def process(topThreeIdentityTheftReportsByYear) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = topThreeIdentityTheftReportsByYear.copy()
    # Keep the real header row and data rows only (drop blank rows / notes)
    df = df.dropna(how='all')

    # Rename columns to semantic names
    df = df.rename(columns={
        'Top Three Identity Theft Reports by Year': 'year',
        'Unnamed: 1': 'theftType',
        'Unnamed: 2': 'reports'
    })

    # Remove the repeated header row embedded in the data (year='Theft Type', theftType='Year')
    df = df[~((df['year'] == 'Theft Type') & (df['theftType'] == 'Year'))]

    # Normalize types
    df['year'] = df['year'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['theftType'] = df['theftType'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['reports'] = (
        df['reports']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df['reports'] = pd.to_numeric(df['reports'], errors='coerce')

    # Filter to Credit Card reports for 2020 and 2024
    cc = df[df['theftType'].str.casefold() == 'credit card']
    reports2020 = cc.loc[cc['year'] == '2020', 'reports'].sum(min_count=1)
    reports2024 = cc.loc[cc['year'] == '2024', 'reports'].sum(min_count=1)

    ratio = reports2024 / reports2020

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'reports2024': float(reports2024),
        'reports2020': float(reports2020),
        'ratio': float(ratio),
        'ratioRounded4': round(float(ratio), 4)
    }])
